title: Training Note: First-Hardship Points for a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Payment
content:
**Training note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A contract whose schedule has never been changed carries first-hardship points on a good-faith payment toward an extension.

**Rule.** When the contract's ledger shows no extension and no due-date change, 5 percentage points are taken off the good-faith percentage; when it shows no extension but at least one due-date change, 2.5 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The ledger is read over the whole life of the contract: an extension entry or a due-date change entry of any date counts.

| Extension entries on the ledger | Due-date change entries on the ledger | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 5 |
| none | one or more | 2.5 |
| one or more | any | 0 |

## Basis Q&A

**A contract moved its due date two years ago and has never been extended — what applies?** It shows no extension but at least one due-date change: 2.5 points.

**A contract was extended once, long ago, and never changed its due date?** It shows an extension, so no points are taken off.
